component.name: Atom Vault
component.summary: Encrypted virtual filesystem with P2P sync over Tor

description.p: Atom Vault is a secure, application-level Virtual File System (VFS). It provides a cryptographic container for sensitive data with hardware-level memory isolation, ephemeral file viewing, and P2P vault synchronisation over Tor — without requiring FUSE or kernel filesystem modifications.

ul.li: Two-layer key scheme: Argon2id/Scrypt KEK wraps a per-vault DEK
XChaCha20-Poly1305 per-chunk encryption with content-defined chunking
Files decrypted into RAM-only memfd — never written to disk
Landlock LSM sandbox applied after vault selection
P2P sync via Arti (embedded Tor), Noise_XX handshake, and Yamux multiplexing
